description: Header file defining the VsockFrameSource class, which manages streaming WebRTC camera data over vsock, converting it to v4l2 format, and writing to a v4l2 device in a guest VM environment.

classes.name: VsockFrameSource
classes.description: Manages streaming of WebRTC YUV camera data over vsock, converting to v4l2 format, and writing to a v4l2 device.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Static method to initiate a streaming session targeting a specific v4l2 device.

methods.name: Stop
methods.description: Stops the streaming thread and closes the v4l2 device.

methods.name: Running
methods.description: Checks if the camera stream is currently active.

methods.name: VsockReadLoop
methods.description: Blocking method that reads frames from vsock and writes to v4l2 device.

methods.name: VsockReadLoopThreaded
methods.description: Starts a thread to run VsockReadLoop, allowing asynchronous streaming.

methods.name: FramesizeMatches
methods.description: Verifies if data matches expected frame size.

methods.name: IsBlob
methods.description: Checks if a vsock packet contains non-camera data.

methods.name: WriteJsonEventMessage
methods.description: Sends event messages to the host regarding connection state.

methods.name: ReadSettingsFromJson
methods.description: Reads camera settings from JSON to initialize device parameters.

methods.name: WriteFrame
methods.description: Writes a single frame buffer to the v4l2 device.
